name: isa-gate
description: ISA gate: is this prompt a request for work with a checkable end state? (asked only for prompts the free pre-filter left unsure)

work.instructions: Is the user's prompt a request for work with a checkable end state, something that will be either done or not done? Work includes changing code or files, fixing a bug, reviewing or auditing something, writing a plan, comparing options and recommending one, and investigating why something in the user's own project or system is slow, failing or wrong. Not work: a question answered by an explanation of how something works or what existing code does, general knowledge, opinions, greetings, thanks, and conversation. A short approval ("go", "yes do it") is work only when the assistant's previous message proposed work.
